system.description:
You can paint ancient glyphs of the celestial bodies upon yourself to invoke the aid of their spirits — lunar spirits provide special gifts, while solar spirits ward off the worst effects of sunlight and fire. It takes three Blood Traits and 15 minutes to inscribe one glyph, which must be exposed and can be inscribed on any willing subject. A single person can benefit from both glyphs at once, but the power fades if the glyph is rubbed off or defaced by the bearer taking four or more levels of damage.

The sun glyph lets you expend a Willpower Trait any time you are exposed to fire or sunlight, converting one level of damage from aggravated to lethal. The moon glyph makes you one Trait down in all tests to avoid frenzy, but grants two bonus Traits on all other challenges.
